items.title: India Bans Sugar Exports Till September 30
items.whyInNews: The Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) issued a notification on May 13, banning sugar exports from India till September 30, 2026, with certain exceptions.

The ban does not apply to sugar being exported to the European Union and the U.S. under the tariff rate quota scheme.
